name: GEMS survey, field 35 (Hubble)
blurb: GEMS field 35, one tile of a deep survey around the Chandra Deep Field South, seen by Hubble.
label: gems35-hubble
aliases: Galaxy Evolution from Morphologies and SEDs
story: This tile is one piece of GEMS, a Hubble survey centered on the Chandra Deep Field South. Across its many tiles, GEMS measured the shapes of nearly 10,000 galaxies to trace how galaxy structure evolves.

claims.text: GEMS-35 is a pointing of program 9500 on high-redshift galaxies in the E-CDFS field
GEMS stands for Galaxy Evolution from Morphologies and SEDs and is centered on the Chandra Deep Field South
GEMS provides morphologies and structural parameters for nearly 10,000 galaxies
